title: Manual-review signal family on the collected altcoin history
hypothesis: A point-in-time structure filter applied to the registered breakout/shock rules produces a positive expected net R per trade on the dev window that survives the validation window, the family-level multiple-testing correction and the matched-placebo comparison.

feature_definitions.name: pivot_state
feature_definitions.definition: the kind of the last confirmed 5m pivot at the signal bar (a pivot is knowable at the close of its confirming bar); the filter fires when that kind is 'low'

universe: MEXC USDT perpetuals in the archived bar universe, BTC excluded, restricted to the preregistered coverage rule: >= 60 days of bars, no malformed rows, no gap in the SORTED series
point_in_time_membership: a coin is a member from the first bar of its archive; membership is decided by the coverage rule alone, never by performance; a coin is not added or removed mid-analysis

costs.slippage: tiered by trailing-24h quote volume (an assumption, not a measurement)
costs.funding: the venue settlement archive on its own per-cycle schedule; friction-only and funding-adjusted results are reported separately and never merged

statistics.unit: R per trade (no leverage applied; the equity-denominated return is not computable without a position-sizing and liquidation model)
statistics.uncertainty: day-cluster bootstrap (B=2000) and coin-cluster bootstrap, reported separately, as interval endpoints only
statistics.family_correction: SPA max-t over the 5 declared members (Holm fallback)

promotion_criteria.name: sample_sizes
promotion_criteria.test: 200 events / 15 coins / 20 days on both splits

promotion_criteria.name: placebo
promotion_criteria.test: the observed mean net R beats at least 95% of the matched placebo means (a missing comparison refuses the freeze)

promotion_criteria.name: funding_delta
promotion_criteria.test: the funding-adjusted mean is not more than 0.002 R below the friction-only mean

promotion_criteria.name: mirror_image
promotion_criteria.test: a fade member beats its own cont control on both splits
